subject: MetricPulse: new analytics subcontractor - information and escrow ask
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom@metricpulse.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Cc: security@metricpulse.com, sara.lowe@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: onboarding DataVault as subcontractor (context + docs)

Hi Ava —

Quick heads-up: MetricPulse is planning to engage a subcontractor (DataVault India Pvt Ltd) to handle batch analytics transforms for our retail partner Acme. This work touches derived telemetry for anonymized usage metrics — we do not plan to send raw PII.

Attachments I’ve included: metricpulse_subproc_roster_20260930.xlsx (roster + roles), mp_security_snapshot_202609.pdf (SOC-like snapshot we share with partners), and a draft escrow addendum (escrow_agreement_v1.pdf) we propose for customers that require an escrow/holdback when a new subproc is added.

Key timeline: we intend to onboard DataVault for a pilot starting Oct 15. Before we proceed we wanted to:
- Share the roster + security snapshot so Redwood can review
- Offer the escrow addendum for customer signature if needed
- Confirm that the subcontractor’s data access will be limited to pseudonymized payloads and ephemeral keys

Please let me know what additional evidence you need and whether Acme or Redwood would like a short architecture diagram call. Happy to loop in DataVault’s security lead.

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Head of Partnerships, MetricPulse
Tom@metricpulse.com
Attachments: metricpulse_subproc_roster_20260930.xlsx (xlsx), mp_security_snapshot_202609.pdf (pdf), escrow_agreement_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@metricpulse.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: onboarding DataVault as subcontractor (context + docs)

Tom — thanks for the transparent heads-up and for sending the packet. I’ve started an internal review and pulled in our security and procurement leads (cc’d). A few concrete asks from our side so we can move quickly and in compliance with the DPA: 

1) Can you confirm the exact data types leaving MetricPulse and going to DataVault (fields and examples). Our legal team needs to verify no raw customer PII is included.
2) Residency / egress: you said DataVault is India-based — please confirm whether any data will be stored long-term outside the EU/US and whether there will be automated cross-border exports.
3) Access model: will DataVault get persistent KV-store access to keys or only ephemeral access via parameterized jobs?
4) Controls & evidence: please provide the most recent SOC2 or equivalent audit statement for DataVault, or at minimum the DataVault security contact so we can request a snapshot.
5) Escrow process: we appreciate the draft escrow addendum. For Acme we typically require: (a) an escrow executed by vendor/customer and (b) tech proofs (restore test) before we accept a new processor in production.

Action items we’ll take: Kimberly (security) will review the mp_security_snapshot offline and send a short list of clarifying questions. Monica (procurement) will scope whether we need an official DPA amendment or a signed addendum with DocuSign.

If you can send the DataVault SOC2 or a security point-of-contact and confirm the residency/retention answers today, we’ll aim to complete our review by Oct 6 and provide a go/no-go for the Oct 15 pilot.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Cc: security@metricpulse.com, sara.lowe@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: onboarding DataVault as subcontractor (context + docs)

Ava / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers inline and attached: 
- Data types: only anonymized telemetry and derived aggregate metrics (see attached roster tab “data_fields”). No customer names, emails, or raw payment identifiers will be shared.
- Residency: DataVault will process in Chennai; no long-term storage outside India planned for the pilot. For cross-border exports we will only push aggregated reports to MetricPulse in the US (aggregates only).
- Access: DataVault will not have persistent access to Redwood-managed encryption keys. They will receive parameterized job tokens (ephemeral) and have access only to the pseudonymized buckets required for transforms.
- Evidence: Attached is the mp_security_snapshot_202609.pdf. DataVault does not currently have a public SOC2 report; we are requesting a recent security self-attestation from them and can share within 48 hours.
- Escrow: we’re prepared to sign the escrow addendum in DocuSign; here is the link for execution: https://app.docusign.com/some-docusign-id

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll provide DataVault’s security contact by EOD and push their attestation.
2) If Redwood requires on-demand restore test evidence for escrow, we can schedule a joint runbook test the week of Oct 12.
3) Target pilot start remains Oct 15 but we can pause if you require additional checks.

Let me know if you want a 30-minute sync with DataVault’s security lead; they’re available next week.

Best,
Tom Reyes
Head of Partnerships, MetricPulse
Attachments: mp_security_snapshot_202609.pdf (pdf)
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom@metricpulse.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: onboarding DataVault as subcontractor (context + docs)

Tom —

Appreciate the clarifications and the DocuSign link. Kimberly and I reviewed the snapshot and have a short follow-up checklist that we will run by Monica for procurement language: 
- We need DataVault’s security attestation (as you noted) before we approve production cutover.
- Please confirm there will be no automated export of per-customer identifiers to any outside systems and that aggregates will be the only artifact leaving the subcontractor.
- If DataVault cannot provide a SOC2 within the next 30 days, we’ll accept a signed attestation + a recorded restore/ingest runbook test for escrow.

Monica — could you please open a procurement ticket for the escrow addendum and confirm whether Acme requires any additional legal terms? I’ll mark this high priority (HubSpot ticket MP-789).

Tom — once the DocuSign is signed and we have DataVault’s attestation, Redwood will issue a short subprocessor approval note to Acme and schedule the runbook test if requested. If anything changes with the Oct 15 pilot timeline, please flag immediately.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
